tools.name: scrape_url
tools.description: Extrai conteúdo de uma URL. Consome crédito somente quando o backend retorna scrape_status=success.

tools.name: start_crawl
tools.description: Inicia um crawl assíncrono e retorna job_id. Consulte get_job até PENDING/STARTED virar SUCCESS, FAILURE ou REVOKED.

tools.name: start_search
tools.description: Inicia uma busca premium assíncrona e retorna job_id. Consulte get_job até o estado terminal.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Consulta um job de crawl ou search. Estados terminais: SUCCESS, FAILURE e REVOKED; PENDING/STARTED devem ser consultados novamente.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Consulta plano, créditos usados e saldo da conta MESSORA.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "scrape_url" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Extrai conteúdo de uma URL. Consome crédito somente quando o backend retorna scrape_status=success." → after: "Extract content starting from a URL. Synchronous: returns the content directly, no job_id. Follows up to max_pages pages from that URL (default 1). Consumes credit only when the backend returns scrape_status=success."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
